title: Crypto Campus Ambassador
scenario: A student recruiter offers commission for getting classmates into a trading group.

answers.A: Click/apply/pay quickly before the deadline passes.
answers.B: Verify inside the official university/account system.
answers.C: Contact the relevant office using published contact details.
answers.D: Reply to the message and ask the sender for proof.

explanation: Crypto Campus Ambassador: the trap is to make money or value leave before the story is verified. The safer move is to verify through an official or approved channel, not to act before verifying.
proTip: Investment schemes tied to recruitment are high risk.
